parent_objective: audit reset-validation result before measured-execution readiness or command design
blocked_by: reset-validation pass must be audited before measured execution design
supersedes: direct measured-execution command design after reset run

public_gates: M2198 must audit M2197 reset summary
M2198 must confirm 288/288 reset success and zero reset failures
M2198 must confirm contract, metadata, forbidden-key, seed-source, and guardrail checks
M2198 must decide whether measured-execution readiness design is admitted
M2198 must not run measured execution or rank profiles
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits reset validity of the repaired executable task panel
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: reset-validation result audit only; no measured execution ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if reset success is not 288/288
stop if contract, metadata, forbidden-key, seed-source, or guardrail checks fail
stop if audit would run measured execution or rank profiles

route to metadata repair if contract or metadata checks fail
route to measured-execution readiness design if audit passes

one follow-up manifest chosen by audit

local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit measured-execution readiness design but cannot compare profiles

no measured execution training ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
